subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should inbound WhatsApp call activity be exposed transiently to agents, persisted as contact history, or remain unsupported?
rationale: This choice controls sensitive metadata retention, authorization, storage ownership, and whether a new hook/tool/config contract should become supported product surface.

options.title: Transient activity events
options.body: Normalize admitted call lifecycle events and expose them through a short-lived, opt-in WhatsApp plugin event surface without persistent history.

options.title: Persist contact history
options.body: Store call activity in canonical SQLite-backed history with explicit consent, retention, authorization, query, and migration rules.

options.title: Remain unsupported
options.body: Do not ingest WhatsApp call metadata if its privacy cost outweighs the relationship-tracking value.

recommendation.title: Transient activity events
recommendation.body: Normalize admitted call lifecycle events and expose them through a short-lived, opt-in WhatsApp plugin event surface without persistent history.
